model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the effect of various language models across different language families. The horizontal axis lists the language families, including IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," has a scale ranging from 0 to 30, with no units specified. Each language family has multiple bars representing different models, including mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2, distinguished by colors. The bars for each model have error bars indicating variability. The IE-Indic family shows the tallest bars, with mBERT-B2 and XLM-B2 having approximate values of 25 and 22, respectively. In contrast, the Isolate family has the shortest bars, with most models having an effect close to 0. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the standard color coding and error bars.
